name: bigbisort-be

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && prisma migrate deploy
scripts.// postinstall: Hostinger's Express preset runs only `npm install`, never a build script, so the compile is hooked here or dist/ never exists.
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && prisma migrate deploy

// dependencies: typescript, prisma and the @types live here, not in devDependencies: the host installs with NODE_ENV=production, which omits dev packages, and postinstall needs all of them to compile.
